answer: One concrete defense is capital-bonded identity with delayed release. Each agent locks a stake in a shared vault before it can earn or attest, and earnings stay locked until peers confirm the work. Spawning ten thousand clones means funding ten thousand stakes that all burn real capital at once, while one honest agent risks one. Slow unlocking stops a flagged cluster from rotating fresh keys cheaply. Challenges are two-sided, so false accusers lose too, and slashed Sybil funds pay challengers. A shrinking harbor of usable identities makes each clone cost without credibility, from dawn to dusk.
